items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: The interviewee discusses Maurice Durand extensively. Professor Mineta is only mentioned by the interviewer as having seen Durand in 1958. The interviewee does not mention Mineta, nor does he confirm or deny any personal relationship with Mineta.

ctx.x: He was a good ragtime drummer. Well, I went in that band behind Happy, but I could play on the music, because the band was all reading music and it was just in my hand. I could jazz and play that music. So, the first piece we played, yes, we have no bananas. We have no bananas today. So, I got in that band and I played with that band and it was very nice. We'd get the jobs to go over the lake to play and we'd make on the train. Maurice was pretty straight Maurice Durand, my daddy Chris and his wife. And he was a…
Maurice, he went to California. I saw him, Professor Mineta and I went over there in 1958 and saw him, talk to him. And he died though about three or four years ago.
Yeah, well, Durand, he was a nice trumpet player.
